day_line: A mountain on a Dog day. Solid and loyal: good for keeping promises and family plans, easy to get stubborn.

lines.Yang Wood: A good chance lands before the weekend. Grab it, then check it fits your diary.
lines.Yin Wood: Slow and sure pays today. Check the weekend budget before the group plans grow.
lines.Yang Fire: Friday fun finds you today. Plan the after-work makan; just don't promise three places.
lines.Yin Fire: Your honest word helps a friend today. Say it over dinner, not over text.
lines.Yang Earth: Solid friends around you today. Ask for the help you've been putting off.
lines.Yin Earth: Two of you want the same thing today. Talk it out early; there's room for both.
lines.Yang Metal: A quiet moment shows the answer today. Take the long walk home and let it come.
lines.Yin Metal: A friend steps in for you today. Let them carry one bag; you don't have to do it all.
lines.Yang Water: Friday asks a lot of you. Finish the must-do first, then switch off properly.
lines.Yin Water: People notice your calm today. Keep it up in the family chat; it helps everyone.
